_note: Active-experiment registry. Read by experiment.load_active() — ONE reader for both the generation path (experiment.generate_if_enrolled) and the live ops producer. Absent file OR absent 'featured' => no experiment runs and generation falls back to the default planner. Unknown keys are ignored. This first experiment is deliberately conservative: its purpose is to prove the experimentation platform behaves correctly under real traffic, NOT to prove det-1.1 wins.

featured.title: det-1.0 vs det-1.1 — spaced-repetition due gate
featured.hypothesis: Interrupting acquisition to review a concept only when spaced repetition says the review is genuinely due (retention < 0.6) produces at least as much mastery gain as always ranking by lowest mastery, without hurting completion.
